subtitles.en: Our top story is Broadcom Broadcom isn't just leading the rally, it's also at the center of the biggest news item. The stock is higher after announcing a new agreement with Apple that
subtitles.zh: 头条新闻：博通不仅是领涨股，也是最大新闻的中心。该公司宣布与苹果达成新协议，股价上涨。

subtitles.en: extends the partnership through 2031 Broadcom will develop custom chips for multiple generations of Apple products. Bloomberg's Consumer Tech and Apple managed to get us a mark gum and also here
subtitles.zh: 该协议将合作延长至2031年，博通将为多代苹果产品开发定制芯片。

subtitles.en: in New York City, super interesting. There is a historic relationship with Apple and Broadcom we can get to. To me reading your report this might be AI server related, what do we think multiple generations
subtitles.zh: 苹果与博通有历史性合作关系。这可能与AI服务器有关，多代产品意味着什么？

subtitles.en: of products means? You know when partners to Apple put out these press releases there is vague as possible, they're not going to come out and say what it is but what I'm telling you is that this
subtitles.zh: 苹果的合作伙伴发布新闻稿时通常很模糊，但据我所知，这是针对苹果正在开发的新服务器芯片。

subtitles.en: is specifically for a new server chip that Apple is developing, they're using some Broadcom technology, this is called ASIC chips, an ASIC chip silicon, it's single-purpose silicon right, you're not going to
subtitles.zh: 他们使用博通技术，这种ASIC芯片是单一用途的，专门用于AI处理。

subtitles.en: need that for anything really other than a singular functionality which is processing for AI and so they're going to be rolling out this chip as early as next year, it's called Baltra within Apple,
subtitles.zh: 这款芯片最早明年推出，内部代号Baltra，是苹果首款服务器专用芯片。

subtitles.en: it's their first server specific chip. Right now for the Apple intelligence servers they use M2 processors, those were made for Max, this is going to be a version of the M5 Ultra which is going
subtitles.zh: 目前苹果智能服务器使用M2处理器，而新芯片将是M5 Ultra版本，性能更强。

subtitles.en: to be the most powerful chip ever, but this is going to have 4x that performance on the GPU and on the CPU side, this is going to have some Broadcom technology in there. You heard it first here
subtitles.zh: 新芯片的GPU和CPU性能将是M5 Ultra的4倍，并采用博通技术。

subtitles.en: on Blueburg Tech, this looks like up 4% at one point it was up 6% and on track for its best days in
subtitles.zh: 股价一度上涨6%，有望创下近期最佳表现。
